description.value: The Captain's Boil is a Cajun-inspired seafood boil chain where diners choose their catch — lobster, king crab, snow crab, Dungeness crab, shrimp, and more — then select a flavour sauce and spice level before digging in hands-first at the table. The menu blends Louisiana-style boil technique with Asian aromatics and proprietary seasonings in a casual, communal dining format. This Richmond location sits in the Capstan Way commercial area and is one of several BC outposts of the Canadian franchise.
